planets.name: K2-321 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-321 with a 2.3-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: K2-321 b was found in 2020 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-321. Its orbit and size follow Thygesen et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
